title: Villa Carmin+A steps from the beach+Pool
description: Welcome to Villa Carmín, a new, elegant and welcoming accommodation. Enjoy an unforgettable stay in this cabin that combines comfort, style and privacy just steps from the beach and within walking distance of bars, restaurants and attractions in the beautiful village of Rincón. Sunbathe in a beautiful pool without having to leave the complex. It is fully equipped and has private parking. The place is perfect for a romantic getaway, a family adventure, or with friends.The spaceVILLA CARMIN is Villa #2. The accommodation consists of a bedroom with two queen beds, a nightstand with a lamp, a dresser and an area for hanging clothes. In addition, it has a sofa bed in the living room, the kitchen is fully equipped and there is a microwave, coffee maker, toaster, rice cooker, pans, etc.Guest accessAccess the complex by pressing the number indicated before arrival on the vehicle entry keypad. Access the Villa by opening the lockbox on the pedestrian gate at the entrance to the complex. The lockbox is the first one attached to the gate lock. description: Tres Soles is a beautiful private vacation home in the heart of Rincon, Puerto Rico. Enjoy panoramic views from the open concept third floor living area, cooling breezes from the three stories of decks, and sun yourself by the lower level pool. Tres Soles is located on Rincon's infamous 'Bummer Hill' area of Puntas, walking distance from famous surf breaks, great local bars and restaurants.The spaceTres Soles offers four bedrooms and two full baths on the main entry level. The bedrooms are located two to a side of a long hallway with a full bath on each side. At the end of the hallway you'll find a tv/lounge room on one side and an exercise space on the other with yoga mats and basic weights. On the upper level you'll find an open living space with a lounge area and full kitchen. The tv in the lounge area has cable and streaming available (log in with your own accounts using the provided Roku device). You'll find a fully stocked kitchen with all of the utensils, pots, pans and basic appliances you could need. We provide a blender, drip coffee maker, toaster oven, microwave, dishwasher and gas range. There is a weber gas grill for your use on the deck off the kitchen.The wrap around upper level porch has dining seating for 8 at one table and a multiple high top tables perfect for morning coffee or afternoon cocktails. You'll also find a hammock on the side porch with fantastic breezes. Exit back through the main entry door and head around the side of the house and down a few stairs to access the pool. The pool is surrounded by lounge chairs and tables with chairs. There is also a grill on the pool level available for your use. We're located in the Puntas neighborhood of Rincón, just a short 5-7 minute walk downhill to beaches, surf breaks, restaurants and bars. Find our local recommendations in our provided guest book before your arrival.Need more space? We also have a two bedroom pool level apartment available for rent with the house. Check outairbnb.com/h/tressolesrinconaptGuest accessThe entire main house is yours to use during your stay (with the exception of the upper floor owners closet). You'll also have full access to the lower level pool and deck during your stay. Our full time onsite property manager, Rob, is available for any questions or concerns during your stay.Other things to noteWe provide all basic linens (sheets, blankets, bath towels, kitchen towels, etc.) as well as one time set up upon check in of toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap and bar body soap. We also provide beach towels and chairs for your use during your stay. You can find umbrellas, surf boards, paddle boards, snorkeling equipment and other beach essentials at many of the surf shops and rental stands around town. Rincón is a relaxed surf town perfect for a family getaway, friends surfing trip or quiet couples escape. Expect lively bar scenes, laid back restaurants and an overall casual vibe when visiting the town.

description: Casa Rivera: A two-level home located in Rincon, Puerto Rico. 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, sleeps 10 people. High ceilings with bright and open spaces. Laundry and 2 kitchens. description: Welcome to your tropical mountain top retreat just 8 minutes away from downtown Rincon!Surrounded by lush greenery and mountain views, this cozy home offers the perfect escape. Enjoy coffee on the spacious terrace at sunrise and cocktails at sunset in vibrant hues.Unwind in the Jacuzzi® Hydrotherapy hot tub, where soothing jets and breathtaking views create the ultimate relaxation.Whether you’re here to recharge or explore, this serene haven promises unforgettable moments.The spaceWith this tropical getaway, you’ll wake up to breathtaking ocean views, fresh mountain air, and the gentle song of coquis echoing through the hills.Discover one-of-a-kind stays in Rincón, Puerto Rico—nestled in nature in "el campo", real charm that offers true peace and privacy.Just 10 minutes from world-class surf, vibrant beaches, and local hotspots, you’ll enjoy the perfect blend of seclusion and access with panoramic ocean views from the mountain top.2 queen, 1 full size beds and 1 sofa bedOther things to noteProperty is equipped with a water cistern but there is no backup power generator. Bedroom windows are aluminum storm shutter style windows, living room windows are glass style storm shutter windows. 4 AC's , fully air-conditioned. 2 parking space for small to medium sized vehicles, 1 large vehicle if parked diagonally. The drive to the property on Carr El Coqui (the fastest route) can be challenging but rewarding, it is a paved road that has high elevation with scenic views with some thrills along the way. The less adventurous route is Carr 412 through La Rincoeña Sports Bar entrance. It's less than 10 minutes away from Rincon downtown and the best beaches taking Carr El Coqui.The street to enter the house is narrow and can be sometimes tricky for inexperienced drivers to navigate. It is not uncommon for mountain top properties though as the roads are historically narrow in Puerto Rico that date back to the Spanish rule.
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours

title: Dos Culebras House-Private Pool
description: Come and experience the beauty of Rincon, Puerto Rico from this spacious and unique property. With its two distinct units, stunning views, and a private swimming pool, it offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation, creating cherished moments.The spaceThis is NOT a party house!
